text_notice: Notice：The general and items be regrouped will disappear!
text_victorysce: Commander! Your excellent tactics has led us to the victory!
desc_skill_02: Movement of troop isn't affected by terrain.
desc_skill_03: Prevent fire disaster in area of troop stationed.
desc_skill_04: Morale of troop will not drop.
desc_skill_05: Greatly increase damage to coastal fort and fortress.
desc_skill_08: Accurate shot trajectory can deal more damage to enemy.
desc_skill_09: Explosive can greatly increase power of artillery.
desc_skill_11: Increase effect of charge of cavalry with sudden attack.
desc_skill_12: High mobility can deal more damage to enemy.
desc_skill_13: Effectively improve infantry's fighting ability with formation.
desc_skill_14: Adoption of infantry tactics may deal greater damage to enemy.
desc_skill_16: Attack power of infantry troop will not influenced by vitality.
desc_skill_17: Decrease damage suffered by navy force.
desc_skill_18: Allow land troop battle on the sea without disadvantage.
desc_skill_20: Greatly increase nobility experience received by general.
desc_skill_21: Increase rank experience received by general.
desc_skill_22: Greatly increase rank received by general.
desc_skill_23: Troop doesn't consume provisions. Not affected by shortage of provision.
desc_skill_24: Increase resource of area stationed by troop.
desc_skill_25: Greatly increase resource of area stationed by troop.
desc_skill_26: Largely decrease resource required to build Bunker.
desc_skill_27: Largely decrease resource required to build transport ship.
desc_skill_28: Largely decrease resource required to build Trench.
desc_skill_29: Largely decrease resource required to build Fence.
desc_skill_31: Reduce resource consumed to upgrade facility.
desc_skill_32: Have chance to deal critical strike when attacking.
desc_skill_33: Have chance to reduce damage suffered to minimum.
desc_skill_34: Increase Infantry one level when general regrouped.
desc_skill_35: Increase Cavalry one level when general regrouped.
desc_skill_36: Increase Artillery one level when general regrouped.
desc_skill_37: Increase Navy one level when general regrouped.
desc_skill_38: Increase Fort one level when general regrouped.
desc_skill_39: Increase Business one level when general regrouped.
desc_skill_40: Increase Move one level when general regrouped.
desc_Militia: Troop constituted by civilians. Quite weak.
desc_Line Infantry: Trained infantry. Main force of land troops.
desc_Light Infantry: Maintain high movement in various terrains. High shot accuracy, low defense.
desc_Grenadier: Constituted by well-built infantries. Strong capability. Can attack still target with grenades.
desc_Guards: Elite infantry with high offense and defense. Can attack still target with grenades.
desc_Machine Gun: The new weapon can deal deadly strike to infantry and cavalry with continuous fire. Movement is quite low.
desc_Light Cavalry: High movement but low defense. Charge can decrease enemy's morale. Capable of successive attack after eliminating enemy.
desc_Heavy Cavalry: Good offense and defense. Charge can decrease enemy's morale. Capable of successive attack after eliminating enemy.
desc_Guards Cavalry: Elite cavalry with highest capability. Charge can decrease enemy's morale. Capable of successive attack after eliminating enemy.
desc_Armored Car: New armored vehicle equipped with machine gun. Charge can decrease enemy's morale. Capable of successive attack after eliminating enemy.
desc_Light Artillery: Good firepower and wide range. Can reinforce or cover other troops.
desc_Heavy Artillery: Heavy firepower and wide range. Can easily suppress enemy with firepower. Movement is quite low.
desc_Siege Artillery: Artillery specialized for destroying constructions. Unable to attack close target. Movement is quite low.
desc_Rocket: New weapon capable of burning enemy's camps completely. Defense is very weak.
desc_Privateer: High movement. Suitable for patrol mission or assault on transport ship of enemy.
desc_Frigate: Good defense and offense. Usually used for escort mission at sea. Can launch ranged strike to enemy.
desc_Battleship: Main force of sea battles. Enormous body is equipped with heavy cannons. Can deal deadly strike to enemy.
desc_Ironclad: Battleship equipped with heavy cannons and heavy armor. Overlord of sea battle.
desc_Small Fortress: Temporary wooden fortress. Can hardly resist attack of artillery. Consume 2 turns to build.
desc_Fortress: Solid fortress equipped with cannons. Difficult to conquer. Consume 3 turns to build.
desc_Large Fortress: Large and solid fortress constructed with most advanced technology, equipped with new cannons. Consume 4 turns to build.
desc_Coastal Fort: Can deal great damage to enemy battleship but not suitable to attack land troops. Consume 3 turns to build.
desc_Trench: Trench can resist enemy infantry's attack effectively.
desc_Fence: Mainly deployed to resist enemy cavalry's attack. Also has some effect on infantry.
desc_Bunker: Can effectively decrease damage of troops suffered by cannon in the area. Also has some effect on infantry.
desc_Star: Medals rewarded to war hero can upgrade army level.
desc_War Horse: Best of breed. Can run on various terrains.
desc_Golden Staff: Staff representing royal authority. Can boost promotion of rank.
desc_Crown: Crown is the symbol of King's authority. Can greatly boost promotion of rank.
desc_Art Of War: Masterpiece of military theory. General can get more experience in battle.
desc_On War: Classic masterpiece of military theory. General can get much more experience in battle.
desc_Encyclopedia: Most authoritative encyclopedia. Can boost income of general's area.
desc_Napoleonic Code: Code formulated by Napoleon. Can greatly boost income of general's area.
desc_Snare Drum: Sound of drum can inspire the troop, keep maximum fighting ability even suffered loss.
desc_Tent Tentage: Ordinary tent. Supply +2 when stationed in wild.
desc_Army Tentage: Professional tent. Supply +4 when stationed in wild.
desc_Military Camp: Top class military tent. Supply +6 when stationed in wild.
desc_Spirit: High degree alcohol. Greatly increase troop's morale.
desc_Medikit: Can heal injured troop a little bit.
desc_Tall Boots: Might and comfortable boots. Infantry movement +2.
desc_Gaiters: Increase soldier's expeditionary ability. Infantry movement +1.
desc_Combat Uniform: Uniform made of tenacious material. Infantry defense +4.
desc_Ferguson Rifle: Advanced Ferguson rifle with extremely high firing rate. Infantry attack +6
desc_Baker Rifle: Rifle with a rifled bore. More accurate than musket. Infantry attack +4.
desc_Brown Bess: Musket with good performance. Infantry attack +2.
desc_Bayonet: Sharp edge for melee fight. Infantry attack +1.
desc_Quality Saddle: Saddle empowering full ability of horse. Cavalry movement +2.
desc_Gilding Cuirass: Cuirass made of high grade material. Cavalry defense +4.
desc_Cuirass: Can protect cavalry effectively. Cavalry defense +2.
desc_Cavalry Pistol: Small gun facilitates cavalry to shoot on horse. Calvary attack +6.
desc_Cavalry Sword: Sword made of high grade steel. Calvary attack +4.
desc_Trooper Sabre: Sabre specially designed for cavalry. Calvary attack +1.
desc_Horse Artillery: Artillery transported by horse. Artillery movement +2.
desc_Oak Wheel: Artillery wheel made of oak. Artillery movement +1.
desc_Canvas Coat: Heavy and tenacious coat. Artillery defense +2.
desc_Potent Gunpowder: Top gunpowder with best explosive effect. Artillery attack +6.
desc_Powder Mixture: Mixed gunpowder with outstanding explosive effect. Artillery attack +4.
desc_Pressed Powder: High performance gunpowder made of special technique. Artillery attack +2.
desc_Brown Gunpowder: Improved gunpowder with stable burning effect. Artillery attack +1.
desc_Armored Carrier: Carrier equipped with armor. Allow land troop battle on the sea without disadvantage.
desc_Figurehead: Figurehead installed at bow of ship. Ship defense +2.
desc_Propeller: Propeller boosted by steam engine. Ship movement +1.
desc_Bow Chaser: Cannon at bow, for chasing enemy. Ship attack +4.
desc_Ram Stem: Ram stem can crash enemy. Ship attack +2.
desc_Concrete: Construction material with high strength. Fortress defense +2.
desc_Eagle Flag: Eagle flag increases supply of neighboring troops. Supply +2.
desc_Bear Flag: Bear flag increases supply of neighboring troops. Supply +1.
desc_Dragon Flag: Dragon flag increases attack of neighboring troops. Attack +2.
desc_Lions Flag: Lions flag increases defense of neighboring troops. Defense +2.
desc_Tiger Flag: Tiger flag increases defense of neighboring troops. Defense +1.
desc_Wolf Flag: Wolf flag increases attack of neighboring troops. Attack +1.
desc_Pumper: Best fire extinguisher. Can prevent fire disaster.
desc_challenge: Your highness, do you plan to march to Asia?
text_tips_1: City, factory, stable, sea port, farm can upgrade and provide supplies for the troops.
text_tips_2: Generals can gain experience in the war to promote the Rank and Knighthood.
text_tips_3: Farms produce food. Troops will be unable to fight in lack of food.
text_tips_4: Siege artillery is specialist to deal with the enemy fortress and coastal fort, and also can deal mortal strike to enemy troops in buildings.
text_tips_5: Each general can carry two items which will enhance general ability.
text_tips_6: Generals with flag can provide support to nearby allies.
text_tips_7: Army of different countries has different capabilities. For example, Britain's warships are stronger than other countries.
text_tips_8: You can exchange resources in Markets, buy items in Stores, recruit generals in Taverns.
text_tips_9: General skills play important role on the battlefield.
text_tips_10: The greater the number of same type unit in formation, the more resources is required to recruit, and certainly will be stronger.
text_tips_11: Light infantry can maintain the highest movement in complex terrain.
text_tips_12: Grenadier and Guards are versatile infantry units. They can deal with various types of enemy.
text_tips_13: Machine gun is poor at movement, but it can deal fatal strike to the cavalry and infantry.
text_tips_14: Cavalry has the highest movement. They can decrease morale after attacking enemy infantry or artillery, and act again after annihilating enemy.
text_tips_15: Target area may easily catch fire under artillery attack. Troops in the burning area will be harmed.
text_tips_16: Fortress can enhance land defense, coastal fort can deal great harm to the ships, but both will take time to build.
text_tips_17: Trench, fence and bunker can provide protection for the troops, but they must be built by infantry.
text_tips_18: Flanking and surrounding can decrease morale of enemy troops, weakening their attack and defense.
text_tips_19: Once the troop is trapped in confusion, they will not execute any command!
text_tips_20: Morale will declines due to insufficient provisions. Troop will be trapped in confusion due to severe shortage of provisions.
text_tips_21: If general has training skill, level of his unit could upgrade through training.
text_tips_22: Do not freely capture ally's buildings, this may lead to break of the alliance relationship!
text_tips_23: When in the sea, the attack of land troop will substantially decline.
text_tips_24: You can unlock special chapter after achieving special targets!
html_notice:
1.City, factory, stable, sea port, farm can upgrade and provide supplies for the troops.
2.Generals can gain experience in the war to promote the Rank and Knighthood.
3.Farms produce food. Troops will be unable to fight in lack of food.
4.Siege artillery is specialist to deal with the enemy fortress and coastal fort, and also can deal mortal strike to enemy troops in buildings.
5.Each general can carry two items which will enhance general ability.
6.Generals with flag can provide support to nearby allies.
7.Army of different countries has different capabilities. For example, Britain's warships are stronger than other countries.
8.You can exchange resources in Markets, buy items in Stores, recruit generals in Taverns.
9.General skills play important role on the battlefield.
10.The greater the number of same type unit in formation, the more resources is required to recruit, and certainly will be stronger.
11.Light infantry can maintain the highest movement in complex terrain.
12.Grenadier and Guards are versatile infantry units. They can deal with various types of enemy.
13.Machine gun is poor at movement, but it can deal fatal strike to the cavalry and infantry.
14.Cavalry has the highest movement. They can decrease morale after attacking enemy infantry or artillery, and act again after annihilating enemy.
15.Target area may easily catch fire under artillery attack. Troops in the burning area will be harmed.
16.Fortress can enhance land defense, coastal fort can deal great harm to the ships, but both will take time to build.
17.Trench, fence and bunker can provide protection for the troops, but they must be built by infantry.
18.Flanking and surrounding can decrease morale of enemy troops, weakening their attack and defense.
19.Once the troop is trapped in confusion, they will not execute any command!
20.Morale will declines due to insufficient provisions. Troop will be trapped in confusion due to severe shortage of provisions.
21.If general has training skill, level of his unit could upgrade through training.
22.Do not freely capture ally's buildings, this may lead to break of the alliance relationship!
23.When in the sea, the attack of land troop will substantially decline.
24.You can unlock special chapter after achieving special targets!
desc_tutorials_word_1: Commander, I'll introduce basic controls to you.
desc_tutorials_word_2: First of all, money, industry, food are necessary supplies of war.
desc_tutorials_word_3: Touch one region to see its Production and Industry, as well as information of this region.(Please touch arrow.)
desc_tutorials_word_4: Each country has its own territory color.
desc_tutorials_word_5: Patterns and colors on the panel represent the type and camp of this troop.
desc_tutorials_word_6: Flag fluttering indicates the availability of movement of the troop.
desc_tutorials_word_7: Different constructions can recruit different troops, high-grade construction can hire more types of troops.
desc_tutorials_word_8: The number of troops in formation can be adjusted when recruiting troops. The higher the number, the stronger the force, but also consumes more food.
desc_tutorials_word_9: Touch troop to control it. White circle indicates movement area. Red circle indicates target available for attack.
desc_tutorials_word_10: You may withdraw step if there is a mistake action.
desc_tutorials_word_11: All military facilities must be built by infantry. Different support facilities have different functions.
desc_tutorials_word_12: Construction of fortress and coastal fort will take some time, and can only construct once per round.
desc_tutorials_word_13: Troop can only cross the sea with Troopship.
desc_tutorials_word_14: You may dispatch general recruited to your troop.
desc_tutorials_word_15: Notice: Building with this icon is a key stronghold. Capture of loss of the building will have direct impact on result of battle.
desc_tutorials_word_16: Touch hourglass in bottom-right corner to go to next phase.
desc_tutorials_word_17: Please read advanced tutorial for better understanding of strategies in battlefield.
desc_tutorials_word_18: Commander, I'll introduce some advanced strategies from on.
desc_tutorials_word_19: Constructions and some terrains have protective effect on troop.
desc_tutorials_word_20: All buildings can replenish injured units. Higher level leads to greater recovery.
desc_tutorials_word_21: Troop will level up after battles. Higher level leads to greater power.
desc_tutorials_word_22: Morale greatly influences troop's power. Troop will drop morale when attacked from both sides or circled.
desc_tutorials_word_23: Morale of troop will have a chance to change when destroying enemy or attacked by cavalry.
desc_tutorials_word_24: If your generals have training capability, you can upgrade the level of troop through training.
desc_tutorials_word_25: Troop can use supply to restore when suffered great loss.
desc_tutorials_word_26: If troops are trapped in confusion, they will not execute your command.
desc_tutorials_word_27: When morale of the troop falls, you can use items to recover.
desc_tutorials_word_28: Cavalry will get onrush effect after destroying the enemy and continue to attack.
desc_tutorials_word_29: City, factory, stable, farm can all upgrade.
desc_tutorials_word_30: Some constructions have taverns, markets, stores, which have special functions.
desc_tutorials_word_31: Troops in fire will suffer continuous injury. The fire is greater, so damage is higher.
desc_tutorials_word_32: Do not capture constructions of ally, and do not attack the neutral country freely.
desc_tutorials_word_33: Commander, good luck in your military career!
desc_1 zone 1: The Anti-France Coalition has seized several cities of our country with the help of rebels. Their fleets has also entered Port Toulon. We've launched attacks several times but cannot repel them. commander, you must defend your motherland and drive those intruders away. Major Napoleon will join your force.
desc_1 zone 2: We're facing crisis now. A new coalition formed by the enemies will invade France from Italy. We are outnumbered by several times. General Napoleon is ready to go on expedition. commander, we hope you can turn the situation in Italy, sweep the enemy and capture the Italian territory.
desc_1 zone 3: Our troops have advanced to Mantua Fortress, which is the last defense line of the Austrians in Italy. General Napoleon is ready to launch attack on Mantua Fortress. commander, enemy will guard the base at all cost. Your mission is to block the enemy's reinforcement and capture the fortress together with General Napoleon.
desc_1 zone 4: You're already respected as hero of France after these victories. Now General Napoleon plans to attack Egypt as the Chief Commander of the expeditionary army. He expects us to colonise Egypt as soon as possible. commander, please be aware of the strong British Fleet in the Mediterranean. We have to defeat them to seize the whole North Africa.
desc_1 zone 5: Egypt is in our control, and next, we plan to seize whole North Africa with Egypt as the base. If you achieve the goal, France will gain vast lands of colonies and can also cut the transport route between Britain and India. commander, General Napoleon has returned to Paris already, so you have to commander on your own.
desc_1 zone 6: commander, the situation of frontline has changed tremendously. The Coalition has launched all-out attack and seized Marengo region in a very short time. Their power has exceeded our expectation. General Napoleon is in urgent need of your reinforcement at present, or the French army at the front might collapse soon.
desc_1 zone 7: The allied fleets of Spain and us were defeated by Britain. An even worse fact is that Prussia also plans to declare war on us, which caused panic. The only thing we can do now is to defeat allied forces of Russia and Austria ASAP. commander, it's time for the last stand. We have to finish the war before the arrival of Prussian troops.
desc_1 zone 8: It seems that the emperor hasn't realized that his expansion policy has increased hostility of Prussia. This might be an inevitable war. Main troops of the enemy have drawn near us. commander, defeat them with your power. The emperor's target is Berlin.
desc_1 zone 9: The empire's troops are pursuing the enemies after defeating Prussia. Now we've stepped into East Prussia region. Their troops have regathered under the help from Russia and formed new coalition forces. commander, once we defeat them, the border of empire will expand again.
desc_1 zone 10: Spain and Portugal are on Britain's side after accepting their assistance. Our troops stationed in Spain are so scattered that they have been defeated by local militia. Another British troop has just landed on Portugal. commander, emperor expects you to retrieve the situation, seize Spain and Portugal completely, and drive the British army to the sea!
desc_1 zone 11: The Coalition by Prussia and Austria has captured Deutsche region controlled by the empire. The emperor has assembled a strong expeditionary troop, but it is surrounded by the Coalition. The enemy is in winning position now. commander, we have to reinforce the emperor immediately, otherwise the situation may not be retrieved.
desc_1 zone 12: The whole Europe is bowing to us except Russia. The emperor has finally determined to go on expedition to Russia. Though we have large troops, the problems of dispersion and shortage of supplies also exist. The most terrifying one is the extreme cold weather in Russia. commander, I'm not so positive about this war.
desc_1 zone 13: The failure of the empire in Russia is inevitable. The morale of the troops has dropped fast due to supply shortage and epidemics. The emperor is unable to retreat safely for the cold weather and ceaseless attacks of the Russian army. commander, victory is not important any more, please secure the safety of the emperor with your troops.
desc_1 zone 14: The empire has suffered a lot during expedition to Russia. Many countries in Europe have reformed new Coalition. Some small countries have broken our control gradually. The empire is facing unprecedentedly difficult situation. commander, the emperor and we all know that, to turn situation, there is nothing more important than a victory.
desc_1 zone 15: The Coalition has issued a mobilization order together. Britain has also dispatched its elite land troops to Continental Europe. commander, we'll stand no chance when their assemble completes. We must take the initiative to defeat Coalition Forces assembling in eastern France. This is a plan of great risks, but at least we have some hope.
desc_1 zone 16: We've won a great victory and regained controls on countries in Europe, except that Britain is making desperate struggles. After a long preparation, the emperor thinks it’s time to launch an all-out attack on Britain. commander, you must know Britain still possesses the strongest fleet in the world.
desc_1 zone 17: All the remnants of Britain have retreated to Canada, their colony in North America. Since we’ve seized major ports in North Ireland, the empire can go on expedition across Atlantic Ocean after a short rest. commander, the emperor has ordered to diminish threats of British, break their defense line on the sea and expand the empire's border once again.
desc_1 zone 18: We've suffered a great loss in previous landing campaign. Britain and US have formed allied force during our wait for supplies. Large number of US troops have assembled and are drawing near us. commander, the empire's target is the whole America, but we might be driven to the sea if not paying enough attention to the strong enemy.
desc_2 zone 1: Revolution burst out in France, even the king was guillotined. Royal households in Europe cannot tolerate such situation. commander, we've formed coalition with other countries and decided to suppress those French who called out to overthrow monarchy. The commander expects you to accomplish mission successfully!
desc_2 zone 2: The enrolment of Coalition has shown effect. There're anti-revolution forces appearing in many districts in France. Royalists in Toulon even begged the Coalition to dispatch troops into Toulon. commander, though we've seized this port, the revolutionary army is pouring at us from all directions. Situation is quite severe.
desc_2 zone 3: French expeditionary troop has landed at Port Alexandria in Egypt. Their victory is unstoppable. The only thing we can secure is the control of the Mediterranean, cutting off supply line of the French army. commander, if you could defeat French fleet in the Mediterranean, their victory in Egypt would be in vain.
desc_2 zone 4: Imperial fleet has won decisive victory in the Nile. Now the Mediterranean is under our control, while Napoleon's army is trapped in Egypt. It's best time to attack France now. commander, we need you to retrieve the territory lost in Italy and defeat French troops in Rhine with Coalition Forces.
desc_2 zone 5: The Coalition of Russia and Holy Roman Empire has captured major territory of Italy in a short time, but French won't give up easily. They've assembled great number troops, planning to surround and eliminate the Coalition. commander, the front line needs reinforcement urgently. You must assist them as fast as possible.
desc_2 zone 6: Northern European countries have issued orders to blockade  all British ships under the threat of France. The empire's sea trade suffered great losses. Even the wood material demanded by the Royal Fleet has become hard to acquire. commander, we need to teach them a lesson. You must defeat the fleets of North Europe and stop the French reinforcements.
desc_2 zone 7: The French emperor Napoleon has made up a plan to invade mainland Britain. France and Spain has formed large allied fleet to challenge our invincible Royal Navy. commander, you mustn't allow invaders to land on Britain. We must eliminate the enemy fleet as well as Napoleon's ambition of conquering Britain.
desc_2 zone 8: French Navy was completely defeated, so they're eager to get the victory of land campaign to save the failure. The Coalition Forces of Russia and Austria are ready to counter-attack against the fierce attacks of French army. commander, this campaign is of great importance. Though Coalition is in advantage, the final victory is not secured yet.
desc_2 zone 9: France has frequently offended us recently. Their troops entered Prussian territory without permission, even drove our stationed troops with force. The king considers it as a provocation to Prussia. commander, we'll form new coalition with other European countries. We expect you to return the insult back to the French on the battlefield.
desc_2 zone 10: France has defeated the main force of Prussia, and continues to advance eastward after capturing Berlin. The whole Prussia will be conquered by France if we don't stop them. Russia has already dispatched reinforcement to assist Prussian troops in retreat. commander, we need to slow down French army to get more time for assemblage of the Coalition.
desc_2 zone 11: Denmark is following sea blockade policy issued by France. Imperial fleet is unable to cross the Baltic Sea at present. commander, accessibility to the Baltic Sea is critical to the empire. The Royal Fleet will fight a road to the Baltic Sea. Be cautious! Denmark is not the sole opponent. You must be careful of French fleet from time to time.
desc_2 zone 12: Napoleon invaded Portugal which refused to obey his order, then dispatched army to Spain under excuse of protecting their territory. Our people cannot tolerate the brutality of French army, uprising to fight against intruders. commander, Britain has dispatched an elite troop which will help you to battle against French army.
desc_2 zone 13: France has sunk into war against Spain and Napoleon himself also commanders in frontline of Spain. It's a great opportunity to attack France now. We've formed New Coalition for this goal. commander, Coalition Forces have finished assembling. We'll launch sudden strike to France. They will be forced to fight on two fronts as long as our plan succeeds.
desc_2 zone 14: France has encountered complete failure in Russia. Their terrifying army no longer exists. Napoleon is retreating to France now. He understands very well about the meaning of such failure. commander, we need you to launch a destructive thrust to France before their reorganization.
desc_2 zone 15: France's failure in Russia has greatly impacted French authority. Countries of Europe are assembling again to resist France's domination. The Coalition is advancing to France now while Napoleon is reorganizing his troops. The decisive campaign is on the verge. commander, this campaign will determine the fate of the entire Europe.
desc_2 zone 16: Our information shows Napoleon has returned to France from Elba, and regained regime. He is leading a new army to attack us. This is really an astonishing news. commander, if we fail, Napoleon will rise again and might control the whole Europe.
desc_2 zone 17: The Coalition Forces has drawn close to French border. Napoleon's failure is inevitable. However, he's assembling his last forces. commander, though Coalition Forces far outnumbers French army, their remnants are elite troops. You must make adequate preparation.
desc_3 zone 1: France has planned Confederation of the Rhine in order to control the Rhine region. Some states of Holy Roman Empire in Rhine areas have gradually left and joined Confederation of the Rhine, becoming satellite states of France. commander, if we don't stop this trend, more states will turn to France, and we'll be isolated by France, even conquered.
desc_3 zone 2: Our empire has suffered a lot due to the ceaseless warfare against France. The empire's surrounding territory has been captured constantly in the warfare. The Emperor believes that we have to retrieve our territory to prove our power. commander, time is limited, but we have to build a powerful troop before the battle.
desc_3 zone 3: Long-lasting warfare in Europe has emptied the Empire's rear defense. Ottoman Empire has taken the chance and invaded our empire and grabbed large territory from us. The emperor was enraged and ordered us to retrieve the land conquered by the enemy. commander, we will let Ottoman Empire pay for their invasion.
desc_3 zone 4: France has suffered greatly in previous invasion to Russia. Elite Coalition Forces of Prussia and Russia are advancing to France. Though Napoleon has deliberately reorganized troop, The emperor thinks that troops formed in a rush will have little threat. commander, let's defeat French army to prove the befalling of a new age.
desc_3 zone 5: The constant loss of France has given us the chance of recapturing Italy. I believe now Napoleon could dispatch no reinforcement to the Apennine peninsula. commander, the Emperor expects us to retrieve the empire's domination in Italy and drive all French out of the Apennine peninsula.
desc_3 zone 6: The France's domination of Europe has completely collapsed. Those satellite states loosely gathered will leave one by one. King of Prussia has called on people in the Rhine to unite and fight against the authority of Napoleon. commander, we'll lead German people to liberate the whole Rhine areas from France.
desc_3 zone 7: French Empire is no longer dominating Europe. Its domination on Germany also collapsed forever. The king believes its a great chance to overthrow Confederation of the Rhine and unify all regions of Germany. commander, it’s your mission to commander the Prussian Army to defeat those satellite states to unify Germany.
desc_3 zone 8: The former Holy Roman Empire has finally split into Prussia and Austria after ages of disruption. The Kingdom of Prussia has already unified, and the Empire of Austria has also regained power. The Holy Roman Empire has revitalized again. commander, decisive battle is on the verge. We'll determine who will be the new dominator of the new empire.
desc_3 zone 9: The Holy Roman Empire has revitalized by our endeavor after ages of decline and disruption. The goal of empire is to conquer Continental Europe now. The first opponent is the former dominator, France. commander, the empire troops will launch attack to France very soon. It's time to introduce a new dominator to whole Europe.
desc_3 zone 10: The empire troops are advancing rapidly, capturing most territories of France. The remnants of the French Army are running westward and planning to assemble in Spain for counter-attack. The emperor has ordered to advance into Iberian Peninsula. commander, you're expected to control and conquer Iberian Peninsula completely at the earliest possible time.
desc_3 zone 11: The empire has already become the dominator of Continental Europe, but Britain refuses to bow to us. Their frequent harassment on our coast line has far exceeded the emperor's tolerance. commander, we'll blockade and destroy the British Royal Fleet. Please get prepared.
desc_3 zone 12: Britain has lost the command of the sea after their Royal Fleet was defeated by the Empire. They're besieged on the Great Britain Island now. commander, emperor has issued an order to land on the island. This will be a difficult battle since the enemy will certainly struggle to the death. Bravery alone won't secure victory.
desc_3 zone 13: The Ottoman Empire has long been fighting with us for sovereignty of the Balkan region. The wars has been fought forever. With the increase of the empire's power, it's time to resolve these issues. commander, if we could conquer the Ottoman Empire, our empire will be able to start expedition to North Africa.
desc_3 zone 14: The Ottoman Empire can no longer stand against us. It's time to take over their territories in North Africa. commander, since we have to keep stability of domestic situation of the empire, the expeditionary troop in your commander is limited in scale.
desc_3 zone 15: The Empire can expedition to America after conquering Europe now. The emperor has discussed many times with ministers. commander, the emperor has appointed you as the chief commander. If you could land on the coastline of North America and set up bases successfully, it would benefit our next strategies. We believe in you. Don't let the emperor down.
desc_3 zone 16: Though we've captured several cities on eastern coastline, we have to face enemy troops which far outnumber our limited forces. commander, the emperor orders to continue the attack, concluding the entire North America into the empire's sovereignty! Our reinforcement is on the way. Get prepared.
desc_4 zone 1: France has dispatched an expeditionary troop to Egypt. They've already captured Port Alexandria and will soon conquer Egypt or even the whole North Africa. commander,  the Sultan orders you to assist the Egyptian Army to resist France's invasion. The British Fleet has promised to offer sea support to us.
desc_4 zone 2: The territorial dispute between the Persian Empire and us has a long history. The Tsar believes we should express our attitude to the Persian Empire by one tough military operation. commander, your mission is to defeat the Persian Army and retrieve our lost territories. Be alert that France and Britain may join this war for respective benefits.
desc_4 zone 3: France is caught in the warfare of Continental Europe. It's the best opportunity to retrieve our territories conquered by France. The British Fleet will assist us to repel the French Fleet. commander, be quick! Capture all targets before France dispatches reinforcements from its own land. It will force France to discard their colonies in North Africa.
desc_4 zone 4: Since the King of Sweden refused to join sea blockade against Britain, Sweden has been listed as an enemy by France. The Tsar thinks it’s a good chance to capture territories of Sweden. commander, our troops will launch attack from Finland according to the plan. Britain will certainly try their best to support Sweden.
desc_4 zone 5: Britain has demanded us to hand over the Ottoman Fleet and fortresses in the Dardanelles, otherwise their Royal Fleet will enter the Dardanelles Strait and land troops will attack Egypt. commander, the Sultan rejected their demands and ordered to repel Britain's invasion. France will assist us in defense operation.
desc_4 zone 6: The independence rebellion supported by Russian has burst in Serbia. If they succeed, this'll become a great threat to other states, and even sovereignty of the empire. The Sultan has ordered to stop the rebellion at all cost. commander, your mission is to suppress the rebellion. Be aware that our enemy might not be limited to rebel forces.
desc_4 zone 7: France has assembled unprecedentedly large troops on the empire's border. The war against France is inevitable. The Tsar calls on the whole nation to unite to fight against invaders till the last. commander, please commander your troop to battle French invaders with other generals. Despite of their mighty forces, we mustn't step back.
desc_4 zone 8: Though our troops have fought bravely, we could hardly resist French army's attack. Supreme Commander has ordered to start strategy of Scorched Earth. We'll give up Moscow according to plan, and burn all the materials during retreat. Severe winter in Russia will have deadly impact on invaders. Commander, time for counter-attack is drawing near.
desc_4 zone 9: Cold winter and epidemics have defeated invincible French Army. Napoleon has ordered to withdraw from Russia. It's time to give them the last strike. The Tsar has issued an all-out attack order. commander. Our mission is to defeat the enemy and drive them out of Russia, liberating the cities captured by those invaders.
desc_4 zone 10: The Ottoman Empire's territorial campaigns with Russia have all resulted in failure, but everything changed after France's expedition to Russia. Though Russia finally succeeds in repelling France, they've suffered great losses. commander, it's our best opportunity to defeat the Russian Empire. This campaign will also determine the fate of both of us.
desc_4 zone 11: Russian Empire is defeated! Ottoman Empire has definitely won the final victory. Though some remnants are still struggling, Sultan has ordered to conquer whole territory of Russian Empire. commander, we must eliminate those enemy remnants. We'll establish a completely new eastern empire.
desc_4 zone 12: Ottoman Empire is defeated! Russian Empire has definitely won the final victory. Though some remnants are still struggling, the Tsar has ordered to conquer the whole territory of Ottoman Empire. commander, we must eliminate those remnants of the enemy. We'll establish a completely new eastern empire.
desc_4 zone 13: The empire's domination of Eastern Europe is quite stable now. The emperor thinks it's time to expand to the west. European countries have formed a new coalition to resist our empire, but they're no match for our army. commander, this campaign will exhibit empire's glory. Go ahead to accomplish the mission for the emperor!
desc_4 zone 14: The empire's troops have swept Continental Europe. Most European countries are bowing to our empire, but some remnants have retreated into Spain and planned to launch counter-attacks in alliance with Britain. commander, here comes the emperor's latest order for you. Eliminate any enemy who dares to defy the empire!
desc_5 zone 1: The war actually began at the shot in Lexington. The King of Britain has officially declared war against us and assembled large troops to launch attack. commander, frankly speaking, we have little chance to win. Our troops are all militiamen with much worse equipment, but I believe justice is on our side. The final victory will definitely belong to us.
desc_5 zone 2: Our info shows the British Army plans to transfer the main force using the convenient conditions in southern areas and launch sudden strikes on our troops stationed there. commander, the chief commander has a new strategy. We'll stop British Army's plan by capturing bases around the coastline with allied forces of France, Netherland and Spain.
desc_5 zone 3: British army has retreated gradually after our long and brave resistance. In consequence chief commander Washington ordered to launch an all-out counter-attack. Remaining British Army are forced to withdraw to coastline and fortresses. commander, we must eliminate British recalcitrant completely, breaking their domination of colonies in North America.
desc_5 zone 4: Revolution broke out in France and a new government was established. Since we're adopting neutral policy, France has listed us as an enemy. The French Fleet harasses merchant ships of Britain and us along coastline of North America recently, but we have no battleships to resist them. commander, the Congress has approved to reestablish our navy force.
desc_5 zone 5: We've purchased Louisiana from France. Though our territory doubles, there have been lots of difficulties to take over the new territory. Spain has conflicts with us due to border issues and natives also attack us. commander, president thinks we have to resolve these issues by force.
desc_5 zone 6: Britain has become largest obstacle in our development. The Congress has officially approved to drive British forces out of North America. At present, British main force is trapped into warfare in the Continental Europe, which brings great chance to us. commander, get ready to attack the British Army in Canada.
desc_5 zone 7: We've underestimated the British Force, which lead to current difficult situation. Britain has dispatched great number of battleships to blockade our ports and deployed many land troops to the coastline. They've already seized our capital, Washington. commander, you must break through blockade of Britain, otherwise we can hardly recapture our capital.
desc_5 zone 8: The end of war is drawing near. Battles in the Continental Europe have finished, Britain could dispatch all main forces to North America. They've also formed coalition with Indian tribes. commander, we are facing very big number of enemy this time. In spite of this fact, we still have to defeat them to unify the North America.
desc_5 zone 9: Since our navy has defeated British Royal Fleet in previous battle, we're now capable of landing Britain Island directly. The Congress has approved the plan of attacking Britain. commander, the President has appointed you as the chief commander. Our troops will attempt to land at Scotland and consequently seize the whole Britain Island.
desc_5 zone 10: After long-term preparation, we're now fully capable of attacking the Continental Europe. Now we will carry out the top secret landing operation. commander, you will land secretly on Iberian Peninsula, conquering Spain before reaction of other European countries. Thus we can construct a base for accessing the mainland.
desc_5 zone 11: The appearance of our troop has shocked European countries, but they have formed new military coalition against us in a short time. We didn't encounter many enemies during advancement until surrounded by coalition forces. commander, ahead of you is a road to hell. We hope you can break through with success.
desc_5 zone 12: We've smashed European coalition forces and conquered most of territories. Remaining countries have assembled, trying to make desperate struggles. Though they've suffered great losses, we're still outnumbered. commander, if you can defeat coalition forces again, we will ascend to be the new dominator of Europe.
desc_6 zone 1: The conflict between colonized people and the empire has been constantly intensified, which has led to local militia forces. They attempt to break free from imperial sovereignty by force. If we cannot suppress those rebels, the empire will soon lose colonies in North America. commander, you must save our colonies from the mobs.
desc_6 zone 2: The rebel remnants have already withdrawn to the central regions of North America and formed huge coalition force with native Indians. French has supplied them with lots of military materials. For stability and future expansion of the colony, the governor decides to launch a sudden strike on them. commander, you'll commander this operation.
desc_6 zone 3: In order to put down French revolution and seize France's territories, the king has already ordered the Royal Fleet to assist the coalition forces. commander, your mission is to land France at Port Toulon with the help of the Royal Fleet, then try to advance to the inland. If we could capture Paris, then the revolution in France could be prevented.
desc_6 zone 4: French expeditionary army captured Port Alexandria. If they continue to seize Egypt, sea route connecting the empire and India will be under a great threat. The king has ordered the Royal Fleet to eliminate the French Fleet in the Mediterranean. commander, they're assembling near the Nile estuary. Destroy them! Besiege the expeditionary army in Egypt.
desc_6 zone 5: The Spanish Navy has always been the biggest threat to our empire. The powerful fleet will take action on us soon with the support of France. commander, we must launch initiative attacks before their operation. The Prime Minister expects you to commander our Royal Navy to recover the domination of sea, resurrecting past glory of the empire.
desc_6 zone 6: France has unified European countries, planning sea blockade of the empire. Our economy will be severely harmed if their blockade plan succeeds. Prime Minister orders the Royal Fleet to secure the trade route of the Baltic Sea. commander, we will become the enemy of several European countries by the sea. You must deploy limited troops wisely.
desc_6 zone 7: France has declared war against Spain. Though Spanish people revolts against invasion, it's only a matter of time that Spain will be conquered by France without external assistance. The Prime Minister has dispatched an elite troop to reinforce Spain. commander, if we can divert the French Army in Spain, France will have to fight at two fronts.
desc_6 zone 8: France has formed the tremendous Mediterranean Fleet in coalition with many countries. It's obvious that they build navy force to compete against the Royal Fleet. commander, the empire has to dominate European sea areas in order to dominate the whole Europe. The Prime Minister expects us to take the initiative, attacking enemy before their assemblage.
desc_6 zone 9: Due to the strategy mistake, the Royal Fleet is besieged by the enemy in the Black Sea. There is no doubt that any tiny mistake will result in great losses in such situation. commander, this will be an extremely difficult campaign. Just be aware again, there is no ally here.
desc_6 zone 10: The empire has eliminated all the obstacles. It's time to have the decisive battle with France. All the feelings between France and us will come to an end in this battle. commander, The king and Prime Minister all agree to assign this hard but glorious mission to you. Thrust your last strike to France and its coalition forces!

desc_occupy 1: Soldiers! It's not time to rest. Go ahead! There're more areas to conquer!
desc_occupy 2: Our troop need to rest here for next attack.
desc_occupy 3: More enemy territory brings more glory. Soldiers, we can hold big celebration!
desc_occupy 4: I hereby declare this territory belongs to our nation.
desc_occupy 5: Soldiers, draw all attention! There're more areas to conquer!
desc_occupy 6: We've already planted national flag here. No enemy can stop us.
desc_destroy enemy 1: Enemy is collapsing under our heavy attack. Soldiers, take more down!
desc_destroy enemy 2: We eliminate enemy so easily. It's a good beginning.
desc_destroy enemy 3: Despite of their heavy firepower, enemy could not stop our pace.
desc_destroy enemy 4: It seems we will be able to gain more prizes at the end of war.
desc_destroy enemy 5: Opponents are so vulnerable. I need true rival.
desc_destroy enemy 6: The weak couldn't survive the battlefield! Victory only belongs to the strong.
desc_alliance protest 1: You've entered our territory. This will break our partnership.
desc_alliance protest 2: I must warn you. I won't tolerate your discourtesy!
desc_alliance protest 3: Your troop appears in the place shouldn't be in!
desc_alliance protest 4: I don't want to see such thing again.
desc_neutral protest 1: I don't want to be your enemy, but that does not mean you can do whatever you want.
desc_neutral protest 2: You really want to keep peace between us?
desc_neutral protest 3: Stop attack immediately, we may still keep peace.
desc_neutral protest 4: Why attack us? Do you want to trigger war?
desc_alliance neutral 1: I regret to inform you that our alliance ends here.
desc_alliance neutral 2: Your conduct has threatened our interests. We are no longer allies.
desc_alliance neutral 3: I've just received the order. Our relationship has ended.
desc_alliance neutral 4: The termination of our alliance is resulted from your miss conduct.
desc_neutral declarewar 1: Although I don't want to be your enemy, but unfortunately, the war begins.
desc_neutral declarewar 2: I just made ​​a difficult decision. My army will attack you.
desc_neutral declarewar 3: You've forced us to take up arms to defend our country!
desc_neutral declarewar 4: It is you that provoked the war. You have to take responsibility!
desc_retreat 1: We must preserve the strength to fight back. The temporary withdrawal does not mean failure.
desc_retreat 2: Maybe I'm too rushing, now we have no choice but retreat.
desc_retreat 3: I have fought to the last stand, but still cannot defeat the enemy.
desc_retreat 4: Tenacious enemy has exceeded my expectations. I need to re-enact tactics.
desc_retreat 5: My troop has suffered heavy loss. Why didn't anyone cover me in my attack?
desc_retreat 6: My army is already unable to adapt to current situation of the war, and must move to the rear to rest now.
desc_dialogue 1: There is no retreat this time, please fight with everything you have.
desc_dialogue 2: Although we suffered great losses, we will never retreat for the sake of our nation behind!
desc_dialogue 3: I will never allow my soldiers to step back, anyone who retreats will be executed.
desc_dialogue 4: I hope everyone understands, this is our last chance, we must seize it!
desc_dialogue 5: It's not rest time now. We need to reach the designated place as soon as possible.
desc_dialogue 6: Soldiers, I assure you that you will reunite with your families soon if you carry out my plan well.
desc_dialogue 7: Our advantage is overwhelming and we must win this war quickly.
desc_dialogue 8: My troop will thrust into the enemy's hinterland like a sharp dagger. We're deciding the outcome of the war.
desc_dialogue 9: My advance detachment has found the enemy. The war is about to begin.
desc_dialogue 10: Although our situation is very bad, the enemy's is no better than ours!
desc_dialogue 11: Generals, I think now it is the time to give the enemy a fatal blow.
desc_dialogue 12: Now, it is the time that our country needs us the most. I will fight to the end.
desc_dialogue 13: Soldiers! Invaders are in front of you, take your weapons and move forward!
desc_dialogue 14: The enemy's artillery can't prevent us from advancing. I will win the final victory.
desc_dialogue 15: Generals, you should be very clear that the result of this war will determine the history.
desc_dialogue 16: This is a god-blessed opportunity, all assemble! Attack!
desc_dialogue 17: Pick up weapons to defend our country. Destroy all the invaders!
desc_dialogue 18: It's time for the decisive battle. Do not be intimidated by the enemy in sight. Follow me, charge!
desc_dialogue 19: In order to eliminate the enemy's threat, we need to launch the decisive battle against the enemy's main force.
desc_dialogue 20: I promise! As long as we win this war, every soldier will get the most lucrative reward.
desc_dialogue 21: I hope we can win, thus we will have the independence and freedom!
desc_dialogue 22: We're about to retrieve the lost lands. Soldiers, catch my pace!
desc_dialogue 23: Everyone is afraid of death! But for the motherland, for the families, we have to face everything.
desc_dialogue 24: We need to attack the enemy positions like flood. Every soldier must be very brave.
desc_dialogue 25: Our advantage is very clear. If we can finish the battle before the arrival of the enemy reinforcements, the victory will be ours!
desc_dialogue 26: The enemy is ready to resist desperately. This will be a very tough battle.
desc_dialogue 27: The enemy has already launched a number of violent attacks. I hope you can understand my difficulty.
desc_dialogue 28: The previous failure is a shame on us, now we must use a victory to inspire the morale of the army.
desc_dialogue 29: If you attack the enemy positions solely, the chance of victory is very small. We need cooperation.
desc_dialogue 30: I can no longer tolerate the enemy's provocation against us. Soldiers, fight back!
desc_dialogue 31: The enemy attempts to surround us. I need to adjust tactics immediately.
desc_dialogue 32: The enemy's general you're facing is merciless! Please be careful.
desc_dialogue 33: This is the enemy 's most elite troop. We can't win if we don't go all out.
desc_dialogue 34: Empire has come to the most dangerous moment. This battle will determine the fate of country, as well as our own destiny.
desc_dialogue 35: Generals, you have committed a series of errors. Our situation has become very bad now.
desc_dialogue 36: We were in disadvantage positions in previous campaigns, even our soldiers are afraid to hear the enemy commander 's name.
desc_dialogue 37: All our troops are put into this war. If we fail, the consequences will be devastating.
desc_dialogue 38: I am ordering all the reserves to join the battle, and I myself will live or perish with our country!
desc_dialogue 39: Soldiers, we are lions, the enemies are sheep. Now it's time to hunt.
desc_dialogue 40: Let all the enemies perish under our firepower. They will shudder when the hear my name.
desc_dialogue 41: Generals, you know my strength, please leave the most exciting part of this war to me.
desc_dialogue 42: I don't need reinforcements. I can deal with the enemy in the front with ease.
desc_dialogue 43: The enemy is simply vulnerable. I haven't encountered an equal for a long time.
desc_dialogue 44: Our enemies should be told that it's still not too late if they lay down weapons and leave the battlefield now!
desc_dialogue 45: Our onrush is too fast. the enemy hasn't realized at all until we are already in their rear.
desc_dialogue 46: There's always a chance on the battlefield! If not, create one.
desc_dialogue 47: Do not underestimate our opponents this time. They are experienced fighters.
desc_dialogue 48: My troop will split the enemy lines like a sharp sword.
desc_dialogue 49: It seems we're very close to battlefield. I can vaguely hear gunfire.
desc_dialogue 50: Our plan has been successful. All-out attack!
desc_dialogue 51: I believe we will secure a quick victory because of your assistance.
desc_dialogue 52: The enemy should be able to hear our orderly footsteps and rhythmic drums.
desc_dialogue 53: The formation of my army is ready. Intensive fires will simply drive away any enemy who attempts to draw close.
desc_dialogue 54: Form formation quickly and prepare to shoot, the enemy cavalry is about to charge towards us.
desc_dialogue 55: All soldiers, put on your bayonets after shooting, prepare to charge.
desc_dialogue 56: We've encountered violent attack of cavalry and must change formation immediately.
desc_dialogue 57: The enemy fortress in the front is the biggest obstacle on our route. We must destroy it completely.
desc_dialogue 58: If you use the Siege Artillery, this will greatly enhance the chances of capturing enemy fortresses.
desc_dialogue 59: We must bypass fortresses in front to reach the designated location under the situation of insufficient troop number.
desc_dialogue 60: I am ordering that all ships must not get close to coastal fort of the enemy.
desc_dialogue 61: The fortress in the front is very strong. It's clearly not a wise choice to attack it.
desc_dialogue 62: The main force of the enemy is drawing closer to my fortress. I will let them know how strong my fortress is.
desc_dialogue 63: The enemy's fortress is too strong. I need artillery support.
desc_dialogue 64: The enemy has almost captured my fortress!
desc_dialogue 65: There're too many coastal fortresses of the enemy. My fleet cannot get close to the shore.
desc_dialogue 66: The firepower of the enemy fleet is very strong. We must find a way to bypass them.
desc_dialogue 67: The enemy's fleet has emerged. Full speed forward! Concentrate all firepower to sink the enemy battleships.
desc_dialogue 68: My fleet can easily destroy the enemy! I hope you can catch up with my pace.
desc_dialogue 69: I will help you deal with the enemy battleships to ensure the earliest landing of your troop.
desc_dialogue 70: My fleet is badly damaged. I didn't expect that the enemy battleships' fire could be so fierce.
desc_dialogue 71: The location of the port you're defending is very important. Please secure it at all cost!
desc_dialogue 72: My fleet will give you full cover. You must land as fast as possible.
desc_dialogue 73: All my artilleries are ready, just waiting for your order.
desc_dialogue 74: The enemy troops guarding the city still refuse to retreat. Let me destroy their last will with artillery.
desc_dialogue 75: When I start the artillery attack, please let your cavalry and infantry prepare to charge.
desc_dialogue 76: Please protect my artillery troop. We cannot withstand the enemy cavalry's attack.
desc_dialogue 77: Concentrated artillery attack is one of factors in my victory formula. Let the enemy fear our firepower.
desc_dialogue 78: Launch violent attack when the enemy enters our range. Do not let them get close.
desc_dialogue 79: Our artillery will fire ceaselessly to the city until they surrender.
desc_dialogue 80: My artillery troop will give you a strong fire support!
desc_dialogue 81: Our cavalry need to bypass the mountains and woods, or it'll be difficult to show our speed advantage.
desc_dialogue 82: Assault the enemy from the flanks. Our appearance will surprise the enemy!
desc_dialogue 83: My cavalry has broken through the enemy's defense line within just few days. Our speed has exceeded their expectations.
desc_dialogue 84: The enemy should be able to hear my cavalry hoofs. Don't they fear it?
desc_dialogue 85: The enemy infantry and artillery are not in the plain, so it's difficult for my cavalry to play the advantages on such terrain.
desc_dialogue 86: City defense of the enemy's rear is quite weak. My cavalry will quickly capture these strongholds.
desc_dialogue 87: the enemy simply cannot stop my cavalry raids.
desc_dialogue 88: All remember! Artillery fears our cavalry the most. Attack continuously when we encounter the enemy artillery troop.
desc_dialogue 89: Our troop has suffered heavy losses. I need your support!
desc_dialogue 90: We've been surrounded by the enemy. It's just a matter of time before our annihilation without reinforcement.
desc_dialogue 91: The enemy troop has broken through our defense. Where is the reserve?
desc_dialogue 92: How did the enemy appear behind me? This is definitely the worst news.
desc_dialogue 93: If we get your assistance, I can end this war quickly.
desc_dialogue 94: Generals, where are your troops? I need you to cover my rear.
desc_dialogue 95: The enemy has cut off our retreat route. The only thing I can do now is to wait for the arrival of reinforcements.
desc_dialogue 96: I will be responsible for the defense here. Generals, please reinforce me as soon as possible.
desc_dialogue 97: The main force of the enemy has initiated onslaught to my position. I need assistance.
desc_dialogue 98: There's not much food left. I don't want my soldiers fighting with empty stomachs.
desc_dialogue 99: Provisions we could carry is limited. We must end this battle as soon as possible.
desc_dialogue 100: Why the food you promised to deliver hasn't arrived yet?
desc_dialogue 101: The enemy farm will provide enough food for us! Soldiers, capture their farms.
desc_dialogue 102: Capture the enemy farms quickly. Do not leave a grain to the enemy.
desc_dialogue 103: We have been surrounded by the enemy. It may not be long before we're destroyed.
desc_dialogue 104: The enemy's attack is too violent. We basically do not stand a chance of winning.
desc_dialogue 105: At this critical moment, retreat means giving up all the previous efforts.
desc_dialogue 106: The enemy troops outnumber ours several times. I think we might not be able to win.
desc_dialogue 107: Generals, face the fact. We have already lost the war.
desc_dialogue 108: The army is starting to collapse. It seems that we need to prepare for retreat.
desc_dialogue 109: The current situation doesn't allow us to launch further attacks.
desc_dialogue 110: The enemy's defense is too solid to break from the front with our existing force.
desc_dialogue 111: The bad weather has made my army lose combat ability!
desc_dialogue 112: Our allies have been destroyed by the enemy, now we can only rely on ourselves.
desc_dialogue 113: My army is in danger of being surrounded by the enemy. What can we do now?
desc_dialogue 114: Generals, we might be annihilated under current situation.
desc_dialogue 115: The soldiers are talking about whether the resistance here is worthy.
desc_dialogue 116: This war is meaningless. Why must I participate in this war?
desc_dialogue 117: Hang in there! My troop will arrive in battlefield soon.
desc_dialogue 118: The troop assemblage takes some time. Please hold a while more.
desc_dialogue 119: According to the plan, I will protect your flanks. You can feel free to attack.
desc_dialogue 120: I need your cooperation to capture the enemy cities. Please give me the best support.
desc_dialogue 121: I will try to hold until the arrival of reinforcements. Please speed up!
desc_dialogue 122: If time permits, I will attack the enemy from the rear in coordination.
desc_dialogue 123: Speed up! We cannot allow the enemy to defeat our allies.
desc_dialogue 124: Due to a large number of enemy reinforcements in the battlefield, my army has suffered great losses up to now.
desc_dialogue 125: My troop has suffered great losses in combat, so we may not be able to help you anymore.
desc_dialogue 126: Allies did not slow down the speed of enemy. It seems that I overestimated their strength.
desc_dialogue 127: I need you to cooperate my actions on the sea in order to secure victory as soon as possible.
desc_dialogue 128: Your army fights so bravely. How did you manage that?
desc_dialogue 129: Excellent! I saw the superb tactics you adopted to repel the enemy.
desc_dialogue 130: You're the best general I've ever seen. If we cooperate, we can achieve more records.
desc_dialogue 131: Defeat enemy in such a short time. You're a genius of war.
desc_dialogue 132: It's my honor to be able to fight alongside such a famous person like you.
desc_dialogue 133: I cannot imagine that all is true. We have really defeated the enemy!
desc_dialogue 134: I have been appointed as the chief commander. I will be responsible for the campaign completely.
desc_dialogue 135: I'm a professional soldier. I'm loyal to my country and people.
desc_dialogue 136: I have executed several soldiers who attempted to flee. There is no need to doubt my loyalty to the country!
desc_dialogue 137: You did not attack the enemy according to the plan. I have reason to suspect your loyalty to the country!
desc_dialogue 138: Generals, I hope we can join forces in the capital of the enemy.
desc_dialogue 139: We have already captured the enemy 's capital. The victory is only a matter of time.
desc_dialogue 140: I've received the command of attacking the enemy 's capital. This will be our most brilliant moment in our military careers.
desc_dialogue 141: In any case we cannot give up our capital. I think you all understand.
desc_dialogue 142: See the enemy's capital? Once we capture it, the war is over.
desc_dialogue 143: We are all very frustrated at the news of the falling of our capital!
desc_dialogue 144: Although we have occupied the capital of the enemy, but the enemy's remnants are still threats to us.
desc_dialogue 145: Cities, factories, stables, sea ports and farms can be upgraded and provide supplies for the troops.
desc_dialogue 146: Generals can gain experience in the war to upgrade the Rank and Knighthood.
desc_dialogue 147: Farms produce food. Troops will be unable to fight if they are lack of food.
desc_dialogue 148: Siege artillery is specialist to deal with the enemy fortress and coastal fort, and also can deal mortal strike to enemy troops in buildings.
desc_dialogue 149: Each general can carry two items which will enhance general abilities.
desc_dialogue 150: Generals with flag can provide support to nearby allies.
desc_dialogue 151: Armies of different countries have different capabilities. For example, Britain's warships are stronger than other countries'.
desc_dialogue 152: You can exchange resources in Markets, buy items in Stores, recruit generals in Taverns.
desc_dialogue 153: General skills play important roles on the battlefields.
desc_dialogue 154: The greater the number of same type unit in formation, the more resources is required to recruit, and certainly the stronger they are.
desc_dialogue 155: Light infantry can maintain the highest mobility in complex terrain.
desc_dialogue 156: Grenadier and Guards are versatile infantry units. They can deal with various types of enemies.
desc_dialogue 157: Machine gun is poor at mobility, but can deliver fatal strikes to cavalry and infantry.
desc_dialogue 158: Cavalry has the highest movement. They can decrease morale after attacking enemy infantry or artillery, and act again after annihilating enemy.
desc_dialogue 159: Target areas may easily catch fire under artillery attack. Troops in the burning areas will be harmed.
desc_dialogue 160: Fortresses can enhance land defense and coastal forts can deal great harm to the ships, but both take time to build.
desc_dialogue 161: Trenches, fences and bunkers can provide protection for the troops, but they must be built by infantry.
desc_dialogue 162: Flanking and surrounding can decrease morale of an enemy troop, weakening their attack and defense power.
desc_dialogue 163: Once a troop is trapped in confusion, it will not execute any command!
desc_dialogue 164: Morale will decline due to insufficient provisions. A troop will be trapped in confusion due to severe shortage of provisions.
desc_dialogue 165: If a general has training skills, levels of his unit could be upgraded through training.
desc_dialogue 166: Do not capture constructions of an ally, this may lead to break of the alliance relationship!
desc_dialogue 167: When in the sea, the attack of a land troop will substantially decline.
desc_dialogue 168: You can unlock special chapters after achieving special targets!
desc_dialogue 169: I have made full preparation, only waiting for the arrival of the enemy!
desc_dialogue 170: We have built a solid defense line to greet the enemy.
desc_dialogue 171: Under current situation, proactive attacks are obviously not feasible. The only thing we can do is to defend.
desc_dialogue 172: You can leave defense task to me, the enemy won't be able to step into our land.
desc_dialogue 173: All drop deeper and wait for the arrival of reinforcements! Hold on!
desc_dialogue 174: My army will put out every bit of effort to defend the city. We won't allow it to fall into the enemy's hands.
desc_dialogue 175: The enemy has built huge fortifications in front of us to prevent our advancement.
desc_dialogue 176: Why did the enemy suddenly appear on my flank? I am ordering the whole army change to defensive state.
desc_dialogue 177: We need get across the river ahead to launch an all-out attack on the enemy on the other side.
desc_dialogue 178: Capture the bridge in the front, otherwise it would take a lot of time to cross the river.
desc_dialogue 179: The enemy has deployed artilleries on the opposite side of the river. It is very unfavorable to us.
desc_dialogue 180: Once the enemy crosses the river in the front, they will threaten the safety of many of our cities.
desc_dialogue 181: If the enemy enters the woods, it will be hard for our artillery to hit them.
desc_dialogue 182: There are large woods ahead. My cavalry will have difficulty to utilise the speed advantage.
desc_dialogue 183: We will launch strikes to the enemy's border from several directions simultaneously. We have obvious advantages.
desc_dialogue 184: My regiment has split and surrounded the enemy troops. It's just a matter of time to annihilate them.
desc_dialogue 185: Here is our last defense line. You should know the importance of this position.
desc_dialogue 186: We must stop the enemy's attack here. Retreat under any situation will be considered treason.
desc_dialogue 187: The enemy troops at the front are very powerful, but the defense at the rear is relatively weak. You should see what I mean!
desc_dialogue 188: The rebels have promised to cooperate with us. It's a good chance to advance now!
desc_dialogue 189: We cannot be too optimistic. Cold winter will seriously affect our army's battle effectiveness.
desc_dialogue 190: We have already prepared more than a year for this war. It would be a huge-scale landing operation.
desc_dialogue 191: The enemy has encountered serious supply problems. It's time to launch counter-attacks!
desc_dialogue 192: It's quite dangerous to attack the enemy without good preparation.
desc_dialogue 193: I'm eager to fight the enemy. Why hasn't the command come? I have been waiting for this moment for a long time!
desc_dialogue 194: We need to capture the city ahead to prepare for the next attack.
desc_dialogue 195: This is the biggest crisis we've met. We have to face the enemy which far outnumbers us.
desc_dialogue 196: Landing troops should avoid enemy battleships. You just need to land quickly.
desc_dialogue 197: The number of the enemy fleet is great. I'm afraid my battleship won't hold long.
desc_dialogue 198: I will pretend to attack enemy's defense line from the front to divert their attention.
desc_dialogue 199: I have surrounded the enemy, and the only thing left is to destroy them all.
desc_dialogue 200: The plan of slowing down the enemy has been successful. Our reinforcements have finished assembling.
desc_dialogue 201: I will not allow any invader to step into our territory! Destroy them at sea.
desc_dialogue 202: Our troops are scattered now. We can only launch attack after we gather.
desc_dialogue 203: Note: the enemy will use their new weapons in this campaign.
desc_dialogue 204: The advancing route of the enemy has been completely blocked by me.
desc_dialogue 205: The enemy's proactive attack on my position is beyond my expectations. I really don't know what their next move?
desc_dialogue 206: My plan has been successful. The enemy has entered our trap.
desc_dialogue 207: Now we need to launch a joint attack at the enemy from the sea and land.
desc_dialogue 208: Allied forces apparently have been defeated. This is not a good news.
desc_dialogue 209: The advancement speed of the enemy is too fast. My defense line is not ready yet.
desc_dialogue 210: Speaking accurately, enemy has occupied favorable terrains before us. We are now in a passive situation.
desc_dialogue 211: Although the enemy outnumbers us, they have limited battle capability. We will win this war.
desc_dialogue 212: We stand no chance attacking enemy from the front. I suggest you bypass the defense line and launch a sudden strike to the enemy.
desc_dialogue 213: Stop the enemy's attack at all cost. Never allow the enemy get close to our coastline.
desc_dialogue 214: My army has launched attacks to the city repeatedly. I believe that the enemy could hardly rest.
desc_dialogue 215: The enemy is not ready to fight, and now their soldiers are very weak. It's only a matter of time to defeat them.
desc_dialogue 216: The perimeter defense line of the enemy has been broken through!
desc_dialogue 217: Our perimeter defense line has been broken through by the enemy!
desc_dialogue 218: The enemy has assembled a large army in this war. We must preserve our strength now.
desc_dialogue 219: If the enemy's plan is successful, we will face the danger of being attacked from both front and rear.
desc_dialogue 220: The enemy has set a lot of obstacles on our route.
desc_dialogue 221: We do not know the true intention of the enemy. A rush attack is quite dangerous.
desc_dialogue 222: It seems that the enemy's plan is beyond our expectation. Our troops are far from enough.
desc_dialogue 223: Part of our troops have been surrounded by the enemy. They need to be rescued immediately.
desc_dialogue 224: The enemy has built a strong defense line. It seems we're in trouble.
desc_dialogue 225: Failure of allies has forced us into a passive situation! Now I have to reconsider the situation of the battlefield.
desc_dialogue 226: It should not be hard for us to beat the enemy, but the enemy's reinforcements are very close now.
desc_dialogue 227: Though we've achieved some victories, our troops have also suffered great losses.
desc_dialogue 228: Soldiers! Eliminate all the enemies in our way. We need to arrive at the battlefield within stipulated time.
desc_dialogue 229: The enemy we face is their most elite troop. So what? We can still destroy them!
desc_dialogue 230: The battle has been very intense, and now no one can tell who has the advantage on the battlefield.
desc_dialogue 231: My troop suffered great losses in last campaign. It's not wise to launch an attack again now.
desc_dialogue 232: It seems that we need to work together to defeat the enemy this time, otherwise we can hardly complete the task within stipulated time.
desc_dialogue 233: You must be very cautious to give orders to the troops every time. The headquarter will not give you much time.
desc_dialogue 234: Time is running out. I hope you can complete the task as soon as possible.
desc_dialogue 235: My troop has captured the most important transportation hub of the enemy.  Now the battlefield initiative is in our hands.
desc_dialogue 236: Ahead is the most important city of enemy. They have assembled all the forces to defend it.
desc_dialogue 237: Our goal is to capture the island ahead. My fleet will cover your troop during the landing operation.
desc_dialogue 238: Capture the stronghold ahead. We must accomplish this task no matter the cost.
desc_dialogue 239: We have always been in neutral position. I hope warfare will never come to our territory.
desc_dialogue 240: We do not want to participate in the war. We just want peace.
desc_dialogue 241: My people and I hope for eternal peace. War itself is a crime.
desc_dialogue 242: Please do not try to invade our land. We have our own army.
desc_dialogue 243: The soldiers are caught in confusion. No one will listen to my orders!
desc_dialogue 244: There are problems in our logistics. The soldiers are unable to continue the fight!
desc_dialogue 245: It is a meaningless war. None of my soldiers is willing to sacrifice!
desc_dialogue 246: I'm unable to command my army. We've lost the war.
desc_dialogue 247: I will burn this place completely, so it'll never fall into enemy's hands!
desc_dialogue 248: Light the fire! Let all the enemies perish in the flame.
desc_dialogue 249: The fire is out of control now. Must we retreat now?
desc_dialogue 250: Fire is the most effective way to block the attacking route of enemy.
desc_dialogue 251: Soldiers! Control the fire. Hurry up to put it out.
desc_dialogue 252: Soldiers! It's not time to rest. Go ahead! There're more areas to conquer!
desc_dialogue 253: Our troop need to rest here for next attack.
desc_dialogue 254: More enemy territory brings more glory. Soldiers, we can hold big celebration!
desc_dialogue 255: I hereby declare this territory belongs to our nation.
desc_dialogue 256: Soldiers, draw all attention! There're more areas to conquer!
desc_dialogue 257: We've already planted national flag here. No enemy can stop us.
desc_dialogue 258: Enemy is collapsing under our heavy attack. Soldiers, take more down!
desc_dialogue 259: We eliminate enemy so easily. It's a good beginning.
desc_dialogue 260: Despite of their heavy firepower, enemy could not stop our pace.
desc_dialogue 261: It seems we will be able to gain more prizes at the end of war.
desc_dialogue 262: Opponents are so vulnerable. I need true rival.
desc_dialogue 263: The weak couldn't survive the battlefield! Victory only belongs to the strong.

desc_victory 2: Commander!You've shown us outstanding military talent with a victory.You will get reward of 25 medals.
desc_victory 3: Commander!Defeating enemy is not difficult for you, the advantage of our army is obvious in this war. You will get reward of 15 medals.
desc_victory 4: Commander!We've defeated the enemy at great cost, and of course the final victory still belongs to you.You will get reward of 5 medals.
desc_victory 5: Commander!You may have committed some mistakes in command. I even wonder if you can defeat the enemy. Such record will not be rewarded.

desc_victory 4 no award: Commander!We've defeated the enemy at great cost, and of course the final victory still belongs to you.

desc_failure 2: Commander!You haven't completed the task within the stipulated time, so we lost finally.
